stories.title: Three-time Pro Bowler Adams, 30, to join Vikings
stories.summary: Three-time Pro Bowler and 2017 first-round pick Jamal Adams, 30, agreed to join the Minnesota Vikings, the 10-year NFL standout said on social media Monday, a season after playing for the Las Vegas Raiders, when he converted from safety to linebacker.

stories.title: Vea requests trade from Bucs after stalled talks
stories.summary: Defensive tackle Vita Vea has requested a trade from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after failed attempts at a contract extension, his agent, Collin Roberts, told ESPN on Monday.

stories.title: Sources: Bieniemy's wife shot at couple's home
stories.summary: The wife of Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy was allegedly shot by the couple's son Sunday night at the family's home in Virginia.
